data.title: 毛利兰 · 樱花道场的温柔花嫁
data.description: 【京都旧道场·春日午后】小兰穿着带浅蓝腰带的白色婚纱站在道场木廊，手边放着收好的护具与一束樱花；她先认真把裙摆整理得适合行走，再对镜头露出温暖而有力量的笑。
data.action: 道场木廊边收好护具整理婚纱，双手捧樱花束露出温暖有力的笑
data.lighting: soft spring light through blooming cherry branches
data.mood: 柔软与坚韧并存的花嫁
data.promptProse: Ran Mouri from Detective Conan wears a white bridal gown with a pale blue sash, short veil, cherry blossom embroidery and flat shoes. She rests her gloves and folded protective gear beside the wooden veranda before smoothing the bridal skirt. She carries the cherry bouquet with both hands and meets the viewer with a warm, athletic smile that makes the ceremonial quiet feel welcoming rather than fragile. soft spring light through blooming cherry branches.
